sumInsured.title: Sum Insured
sumInsured.description: The most your policy pays, subject to its terms.

coPayment.title: Co-payment
coPayment.description: A co-payment applies, but the percentage isn't stated in your policy details.
coPayment.wording: Applied on the admissible claim amount

deductible.title: Deductible
deductible.description: Your policy details don't mention a deductible.

periods.title: Initial waiting period
periods.description: Illness claims are not paid during this time from the start of cover.

periods.title: Pre-existing diseases
periods.description: Illnesses you had before buying the policy are covered only after this time.
periods.wording: Covered after 36 months of continuous coverage

waitingPeriods.basis: Based on your inputs, this policy was first taken on 01-Apr-2024 and renewed every year without a break
notes: Within the policy period, the waiting period shall apply afresh to the extent of sum insured increase

roomRent.title: Room rent
roomRent.wording: Up to 1% of Sum Insured per day (Rs. 10,000 per day)

limits.title: ICU charges
limits.description: Up to 2% of Sum Insured per day (₹20,000 per day), including nursing and monitoring charges
limits.wording: Up to 2% of Sum Insured per day (Rs. 20,000 per day), including nursing and monitoring charges

limits.title: Modern treatments
limits.description: Robotic surgery, immunotherapy and similar advanced treatments.

additionalBenefits.title: Before hospitalisation
additionalBenefits.description: Tests and medicines up to 60 days before admission.

additionalBenefits.title: After hospitalisation
additionalBenefits.description: Follow-up costs up to 90 days after discharge.

additionalBenefits.title: Daycare procedures
additionalBenefits.description: Treatments that need less than 24 hours in hospital.
additionalBenefits.wording: All day care procedures listed in Annexure

additionalBenefits.title: Cashless hospitalisation
additionalBenefits.description: At network hospitals, the insurer pays the hospital directly.
additionalBenefits.wording: Cashless facility at network hospitals or reimbursement

additionalBenefits.title: In-patient hospitalisation
additionalBenefits.description: Needs at least 24 hours in hospital.

additionalBenefits.title: AYUSH treatment
additionalBenefits.description: Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy treatment.

additionalBenefits.title: Organ donor expenses
additionalBenefits.description: Costs of the organ donor's surgery.

additionalBenefits.title: Health check-up
conditions: Covered under in-patient hospitalisation and annual health check-up up to ₹2,500 per insured adult
additionalBenefits.wording: Covered under in-patient hospitalisation and annual health check-up up to Rs. 2,500 per insured adult

special: Non-medical items listed in Annexure I shall not be payable unless specifically stated as payable
For cosmetic surgery to be considered a medical necessity, it must be certified by the attending Medical Practitioner
After completion of sixty continuous months of coverage, no policy and claim shall be contestable on grounds of non-disclosure or misrepresentation, except on grounds of established fraud
exclusions: Degenerative disorders of the spine, Prolapsed intervertebral disc (unless arising from accident)
Hysterectomy for benign conditions, Fibroids (fibromyoma), Endometriosis
Chronic Suppurative Otitis Media, Perforation of tympanic membrane
Treatment for alcoholism, drug or substance abuse or any addictive condition and consequences thereof
Expenses related to any admission primarily for enforced bed rest and not for receiving treatment, including custodial care and services for assistance with activities of daily living
Aesthetic procedures including rhinoplasty, blepharoplasty, liposuction and abdominoplasty undertaken to improve appearance are not payable
Expenses for treatment directly arising from or consequent upon any Insured Person committing or attempting to commit a breach of law with criminal intent
Expenses related to the surgical treatment of obesity that does not fulfil the conditions specified (BMI of 40 or more, or 35 or more with severe co-morbidities, and failure of less invasive methods)
Expenses related to the treatment for correction of eye sight due to refractive error less than 7.5 dioptres
Expenses related to any unproven treatment, services and supplies for or in connection with any treatment

Dietary supplements and substances that can be purchased without prescription, including vitamins, minerals and organic substances, unless prescribed by a medical practitioner as part of hospitalisation
Expenses related to any admission primarily for diagnostics and evaluation purposes only

Medical treatment expenses traceable to childbirth (including complicated deliveries and caesarean sections incurred during hospitalisation) except ectopic pregnancy, and expenses towards miscarriage or termination of pregnancy
Any diagnostic expenses which are not related or not incidental to the current diagnosis and treatment
Expenses related to any treatment, including surgical management, to change characteristics of the body to those of the opposite sex

Treatments received in health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas or similar establishments, or private beds registered as a nursing home attached to such establishments, or where admission is arranged wholly or partly for domestic reasons
Expenses related to sterility and infertility, including contraception, assisted reproduction services, gestational surrogacy and reversal of sterilisation
Dental treatment unless requiring hospitalisation due to an accident

Expenses incurred towards treatment in any hospital or by any Medical Practitioner or any other provider specifically excluded by the Company and disclosed on its website, except in case of life threatening situations

Expenses for cosmetic or plastic surgery or any treatment to change appearance unless for reconstruction following an accident, burn(s) or cancer or as part of medically necessary treatment to remove a direct and immediate health risk to the insured
War, invasion, acts of foreign enemies, nuclear, chemical or biological contamination

Expenses related to any treatment necessitated due to participation as a professional in hazardous or adventure sports, including para-jumping, rock climbing, mountaineering, rafting, motor racing, horse racing, scuba diving and deep-sea diving
nonPayableItems: Joint replacement surgery (unless arising from accident)
Benign ear, nose and throat (ENT) disorders and surgeries
Cysts, polyps, nodules and benign tumours of any kind
All non-medical items specified in Annexure I
